DA_GE_start_distribution_Dense_Muscle = {
	add_treasury = -300
	DA_alchemy_reagents_spend = { amount = 10 }
	custom_tooltip = DA_GE_dist_start_Dense_Muscle_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_distributing.Dense_Muscle
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_dist_active
		set_variable = { which = DA_GE_dist_left value = 6 }
		DA_GE_recount = yes
	}
}
DA_GE_remove_Dense_Muscle = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Dense_Muscle
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GE_aug.Dense_Muscle
	add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GE_scar.Dense_Muscle duration = 1825 }
	hidden_effect = { DA_GE_recount = yes }
}

DA_GE_start_sequencing_Centaur_Stride = {
	add_treasury = -600
	DA_alchemy_reagents_spend = { amount = 10 }
	largest_decrease_of_centaur_tolerance_effect = yes
	custom_tooltip = DA_GE_race_opinion_Centaur_Stride_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				culture_is_centaur = yes
				NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			}
			add_opinion = { who = ROOT modifier = DA_GE_genetic_violation }
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = DA_GE_seq_start_Centaur_Stride_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Centaur_Stride

DA_GE_finish_sequencing = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Giants_Power }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Giants_Power
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Giants_Power
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_just_sequenced.Giants_Power
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Endurance_Tissue }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Endurance_Tissue
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Endurance_Tissue
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_just_sequenced.Endurance_Tissue
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Predator_Sinew }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Predator_Sinew
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Predator_Sinew
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_just_sequenced.Predator_Sinew
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Worm_Heart }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Worm_Heart
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Worm_Heart
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_just_sequenced.Worm_Heart
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Hydra_Regeneration }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Hydra_Regeneration
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Hydra_Regeneration
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_just_sequenced.Hydra_Regeneration
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Carapace_Plating }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Carapace_Plating
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Carapace_Plating
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_just_sequenced.Carapace_Plating
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Hollow_Bones }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Hollow_Bones
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Hollow_Bones
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_just_sequenced.Hollow_Bones
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Compact_Frame }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GE_sequencing.Compact_Frame
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Compact_Frame
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_just_sequenced.Compact_Frame
	}
	if = {

DA_GE_sequencing_tick = {
	change_variable = { which = DA_GE_seq_progress value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { DA_completed.Medicine_1 = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_seq_progress value = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_completed.Medicine_2 = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_seq_progress value = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_completed.Medicine_3 = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_seq_progress value = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_completed.Medicine_4 = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_seq_progress value = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GE_seq_progress which = DA_GE_seq_needed } }
		DA_GE_finish_sequencing = yes
	}
}

DA_GE_distribution_tick = {
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_GE_dist_left value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GE_dist_left value = 0.5 } } }
		DA_GE_finish_distribution = yes
	}
}

		limit = { has_country_modifier = DA_GE_scar.Ruinborn_Resilience }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_gc value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = DA_GE_scar.Troll_Regeneration }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_gc value = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_GE_cap value = 6 }
	if = {
		limit = { DA_completed.Medicine_1 = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_cap value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_completed.Medicine_2 = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_cap value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_completed.Medicine_3 = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_cap value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_completed.Medicine_4 = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_cap value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_DL_lab_tier_3 = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_cap value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_DL_lab_tier_2 = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_cap value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_DL_lab_tier_1 = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_cap value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Genomic_Stabilizer }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_cap value = 2 }
	}
	change_variable = { which = DA_GE_cap which = DA_GE_stable_mutations }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GE_ratio which = DA_GE_gc }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_GE_ratio value = 100 }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_GE_ratio which = DA_GE_cap }
	round_variable = { which = DA_GE_ratio value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GE_ratio value = 151 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GE_band value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GE_ratio value = 126 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GE_band value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GE_ratio value = 101 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GE_band value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_GE_band value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GE_band value = 1 }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GE_band.1 } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GE_band.1 duration = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GE_band value = 1 } }
			has_country_modifier = DA_GE_band.1 }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GE_band.1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GE_band value = 2 }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GE_band.2 } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GE_band.2 duration = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GE_band value = 2 } }
			has_country_modifier = DA_GE_band.2 }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GE_band.2
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GE_band value = 3 }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GE_band.3 } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GE_band.3 duration = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GE_band value = 3 } }
			has_country_modifier = DA_GE_band.3 }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GE_band.3
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Muscular value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Dense_Muscle }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Muscular value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Giants_Power }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Muscular value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Endurance_Tissue }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Muscular value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Predator_Sinew }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Muscular value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Worm_Heart }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Muscular value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Hydra_Regeneration }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Muscular value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Muscular value = 3 }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GE_mastery.Muscular } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GE_mastery.Muscular duration = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Muscular value = 3 } }
			has_country_modifier = DA_GE_mastery.Muscular }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GE_mastery.Muscular
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Skeletal value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Dense_Bones }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Skeletal value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Carapace_Plating }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Skeletal value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Hollow_Bones }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Skeletal value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Compact_Frame }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Skeletal value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Basilisk_Hide }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Skeletal value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Earthbone_Lattice }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Skeletal value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Skeletal value = 3 }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GE_mastery.Skeletal } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GE_mastery.Skeletal duration = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Skeletal value = 3 } }
			has_country_modifier = DA_GE_mastery.Skeletal }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GE_mastery.Skeletal
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Neural value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Enhanced_Instinct }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Neural value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Cold_Logic }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Neural value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Serene_Mind }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Neural value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Eidetic_Memory }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Neural value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Draconic_Senses }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Neural value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Whispering_Mind }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GE_count_Neural value = 1 }
	}
	if = {

			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GE_mastery.Neural } }

}

# on_monthly_pulse for countries on the path. Mutations are rolled in DA_Genetic_Engineering_events.20.
DA_GE_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_seq_active }
		DA_GE_sequencing_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_dist_active }
		DA_GE_distribution_tick = yes
	}
	DA_GE_recount = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GE_band value = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Genetic_Engineering_events.20 }
	}
}

# Called by DA_project_event.360 (Transcendence) and by DA_Hul_Jorkad_event.4 (Ducaniel's Laboratory tier III).
DA_GE_unlock_path = {
	set_country_flag = DA_unlocked.genetic_engineering
	set_country_flag = DA_GE_active
	set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Dense_Muscle
	set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Dense_Bones
	set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Enhanced_Instinct
	set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Common_Magic
	set_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Enhanced_Fertility
	set_variable = { which = DA_GE_stable_mutations value = 0 }
	DA_GE_recount = yes
	country_event = { id = DA_Genetic_Engineering_events.3 days = 1 }
}

######## Interface ########

DA_GE_select_default_tab = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_tab.Muscular has_country_flag = DA_GE_tab.Skeletal has_country_flag = DA_GE_tab.Neural has_country_flag = DA_GE_tab.Arcane has_country_flag = DA_GE_tab.Special has_country_flag = DA_GE_tab.Races } } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GE_tab.Muscular
	}
}
DA_GE_open_tab = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on_Genetic_Engineering
	clr_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on_Mana_Core
	clr_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on_Mega_Engineering
	set_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on_Genetic_Engineering
	DA_GE_select_default_tab = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_active }
		DA_GE_recount = yes
	}
}
DA_GE_open_interface = {
	set_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on
	DA_GE_open_tab = yes
}
DA_GE_select_tab_clear = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GE_tab.Muscular
	clr_country_flag = DA_GE_tab.Skeletal
	clr_country_flag = DA_GE_tab.Neural
	clr_country_flag = DA_GE_tab.Arcane
	clr_country_flag = DA_GE_tab.Special
	clr_country_flag = DA_GE_tab.Races
}

######## Ducaniel's Laboratory: ruler trait research (country scope) ########

DA_DL_recount = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_DL_traits_unlocked value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_can_add_DA_Minor_Enhanced_brain_personality }
		change_variable = { which = DA_DL_traits_unlocked value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_can_add_DA_Minor_Warrior_mentality_personality }
		change_variable = { which = DA_DL_traits_unlocked value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_can_add_DA_Minor_Pheromones_personality }
		change_variable = { which = DA_DL_traits_unlocked value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_can_add_DA_Minor_Living_calculator_personality }
		change_variable = { which = DA_DL_traits_unlocked value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_can_add_DA_Minor_Perceptive_personality }
		change_variable = { which = DA_DL_traits_unlocked value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_can_add_DA_Enhanced_brain_personality }
		change_variable = { which = DA_DL_traits_unlocked value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_can_add_DA_Warrior_mentality_personality }
		change_variable = { which = DA_DL_traits_unlocked value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_can_add_DA_Pheromones_personality }
		change_variable = { which = DA_DL_traits_unlocked value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_can_add_DA_Living_calculator_personality }
		change_variable = { which = DA_DL_traits_unlocked value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_can_add_DA_Perceptive_personality }
		change_variable = { which = DA_DL_traits_unlocked value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_can_add_DA_Damestear_dwarf_personality }
		change_variable = { which = DA_DL_traits_unlocked value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_DL_pct value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_DL_needed value = 0.001 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_DL_pct which = DA_DL_progress }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_DL_pct value = 100 }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_DL_pct which = DA_DL_needed }
		round_variable = { which = DA_DL_pct value = 0 }
	}
}
DA_DL_toggle_research = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_research_on }
		clr_country_flag = DA_DL_research_on
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_paid } }
			add_treasury = -500
			DA_alchemy_reagents_spend = { amount = 10 }
			hidden_effect = {
				set_country_flag = DA_DL_paid
				set_variable = { which = DA_DL_progress value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { DA_DL_research_stage_1 = yes }
					set_variable = { which = DA_DL_needed value = 12 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { DA_DL_research_stage_2 = yes }
					set_variable = { which = DA_DL_needed value = 24 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { DA_DL_research_stage_3 = yes }
					set_variable = { which = DA_DL_needed value = 48 }
				}
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = DA_DL_research_on
	}
	hidden_effect = { DA_DL_recount = yes }
}
# on_monthly_pulse while the research runs. The trait is rolled in DA_Hul_Jorkad_event.9.
DA_DL_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_DL_trait_available = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_DL_progress value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { DA_DL_lab_tier_3 = yes }
			change_variable = { which = DA_DL_progress value = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_DL_progress which = DA_DL_needed } }
			clr_country_flag = DA_DL_research_on
			clr_country_flag = DA_DL_paid
			set_variable = { which = DA_DL_progress value = 0 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_DL_needed value = 0 }
			country_event = { id = DA_Hul_Jorkad_event.9 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = DA_DL_research_on
	}
	DA_DL_recount = yes
}
DA_DL_open_ruler_modification = {
	DA_save_current_personalties = yes
	country_event = { id = DA_Hul_Jorkad_event.11 }
}
DA_DL_open_genetic_engineering = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_show_wonder_The_Dwarven_Laboratory
	DA_GE_open_interface = yes
}
